name: Dootly – Better Outreach
author: Deepak Khokhar

sections.description:
Dootly Better Outreach plugin allows you to setup a list for email and message marketing compaigns.

Enter the title for your list under the plugin’s settings. Click add people and enter the contact information of each person. Click save button after you add all people.

Key Features

  • List Building – Create a list of your customers automatically.
  • Outreach – Send emails and messages based on customer actions on your website.
  • Track – Track users actions and send personalized email with coupons and offers.
sections.installation:
You can install the Plugin in two ways.

WordPress interface installation

  1. Go to plugins in the WordPress admin and click on “Add new”.
  2. In the Search box enter “Dootly – Better Outreach” and press Enter.
  3. Click on “Install” to install the plugin.
  4. Activate the plugin.

Manual installation

  1. Download and upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/dootly directory from the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress admin area.
